critical_code_review_comments: inspirations_archive.py is now 727 lines — crossed the 700-line threshold from the code-review guideline. Recommend extracting the _run_cultural_reading / _kick_off_cultural_reading / _save_cultural_reading helpers into a dedicated `cultural_engine/pipeline.py` orchestrator module, keeping the router file focused on HTTP concerns only.

_kick_off_cultural_reading falls back to asyncio.run() inside a sync context — safe under FastAPI BackgroundTasks today, but creating a fresh event loop per background task is fragile if invoked from worker threads. Consider using starlette.concurrency.run_in_threadpool + an awaitable variant, or always relying on the FastAPI lifespan loop via asyncio.get_running_loop().

_save_cultural_reading swallows persistence errors with logger.warning only — a vision pipeline that ran successfully but failed to write back to media_library would leave the row in 'pending' forever with no surfaced error. Add a retry or at least surface 'failed' status on persist failure.

POST /archive/{id}/cultural-reading is unauthenticated against role-based permission checks (only tenant context). Re-running the pipeline costs OpenAI + Claude calls — consider gating on P_INSPIRATIONS_WRITE or super_admin to prevent client-role abuse.

Layer-1 vision request follows redirects and downloads the image url server-side; no SSRF guard. Recommend validating that resolved hosts are public (deny RFC1918/localhost) before passing to vision_provider_adapter.analyze_image.
